title: What It Actually Looks Like to Judge Yourself Harder Than You Judge Him
caption:
Matthew 7 was never permission to skip correction. It was permission to earn the right to give it.

Take the log out of your own eye first. Use the same measure on yourself that you use on him. Then speak to his failure the way Christ spoke to yours.

Be the hardest judge you know, and the softest.

#faith #grace #christianmen #character #manofgod
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
